Changelog

Source: CHANGELOG.md

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

[Unreleased]

Changed

  • Updated DriverAverages scraper base URL for the second-tier series from nascar_xfinityseries/ to nascar_secondseries/ to match upstream rebrand.

Fixed

  • Restored missing 2025 S1 and S2 stage data across Cup, NXS, and Truck series (#41).

[3.1.0] - 2026-06-11

Added

  • Added export_series() function to export series datasets to local CSV or Parquet files.
  • Added support for automated CSV generation and upload to Cloudflare R2 alongside Parquet.
  • Added ingesting-nascar-data vignette detailing direct access URLs and type-coercion considerations.

[3.0.1] - 2026-05-06

Changed

  • Replaced persistent on-disk caching with in-memory session caching in load_series() to prevent stale local data.

[3.0.0] - 2026-05-06

Changed

  • Migrated canonical datasets out of the package bundle to Cloudflare R2 remote storage.
  • Added load_series() dynamic reader function.
